heading: Imposition of lac cess
title: Imposition of lac cess
text: 3. Imposition of lac cess. There shall be levied and collected on all lac and refuse lac exported from Pakistan * * * a cess at the rate of seven annas per maund in the case of lac, and five annas per maund in the case of refuse lac, or at such other rate as the Federal Government may, * * *, by notification in the official Gazette, prescribe.
